describes: `409` · `REFUND_ALREADY_REQUESTED`. The delivery and service fees are refunded at most once: by `FEES_ONLY`, or as part of a `FULL` refund when no other refund holds them. A second `FEES_ONLY` refund on the order is refused; nothing is created. (A `FULL` refund never clashes: it takes only what no other refund holds.)

error.message: The delivery fees on this order have already been refunded.
